expo.name: BoulderRoller
expo._comment: app.config.ts is the source of truth for build config — see SOLANA_MOBILE_BUILD_NOTES.md §2.2. This file mirrors app.config.ts so a reviewer glancing here does not see drift. If you are editing build config, edit app.config.ts.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BoulderRoller uses your location to record cycling rides and detect climbs.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BoulderRoller needs background location access to record your ride while the screen is off.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: BoulderRoller connects to your power meter, heart rate strap, and cadence sensors over Bluetooth.
